system.description:
The landless knight: untitled and unsponsored, some left without a lord and others self-made in battle. No keep, no banner, just the code you chose.

  • Steadfast Courage (1st): you know the Embolden Command from 1st level rather than 9th; it reaches 60ft, and companions and followers in range have Advantage on all saves.
  • Common Ground (1st): Advantage on Charisma checks with common folk, mercenaries and anyone who distrusts titled nobility.
  • Captain of Commoners (5th): allied hirelings, followers and common folk who can see you have Advantage on morale checks.
  • Banner Without a Keep (10th): a squire and 1d6 commoners (all Level 0) travel with you; any who fall or leave are replaced each season.
  • Your scutage pays them, 3 gp a month each.
  • From 20th, your Renown: Castle needs no castle: followers gather wherever you hold a camp or a hall for a season.
